button.label: Assist
button.screentip: What is this email and what should I do with it?
button.supertip: Reads the thread, says what it is and what is being asked of you, and suggests next steps.

button.label: Draft Reply
button.supertip: Reads the whole thread and its attachments and drafts a reply in the pane. Nothing is sent: you insert the draft into a reply and send it yourself.

button.label: Draft with Instructions...
button.screentip: Say what the reply should do, then draft it

button.label: Summarize
button.supertip: What it is about, what is asked of you, dates and decisions, and open questions.

button.label: Extract Tasks
button.screentip: List what this thread leaves you to do
button.supertip: Shows the actions with any deadlines. Tick the ones to add to your Outlook tasks.

menu.label: Follow Up
menu.supertip: Flags the email with a reminder on the morning of the day you choose. For mailboxes that cannot hold dated flags, a task is created instead.

button.label: Write from Brief
button.screentip: Write an email from a one-line description
button.supertip: Type what the email should say in the pane. In a reply or a new email the result is inserted there; otherwise a new email is opened.

button.label: Polish
button.supertip: Works on the text you have highlighted in the email you are writing, or on everything you have typed if nothing is highlighted. Fixes grammar and awkward phrasing without changing what you say.

button.label: Find Times
button.screentip: Find meeting times that are free in your calendar
button.supertip: Reads what the thread is trying to arrange, checks the calendars you ticked in Settings, and lists free times. Tick the ones to offer and PApii drafts the reply. Only free and busy times are used, never what your calendar entries say.

button.label: Add to Calendar
button.screentip: Add the meeting this thread agrees on to your calendar
button.supertip: Finds the date, time and place in the thread and shows them for you to check. Nothing is created until you click Add to calendar.

dropDown.label: Model
dropDown.supertip: Haiku is fastest. Sonnet is the balanced default. Opus and Fable are the most capable and use more of your plan's limit.

dropDown.label: Effort
dropDown.screentip: How much thinking the model does
dropDown.supertip: Higher effort is slower and uses more of your plan's limit.

dropDown.label: Tone
dropDown.supertip: Auto matches the tone of the thread.

checkBox.label: Read attachments
checkBox.supertip: When ticked, attachments in the thread are read along with the messages. Untick for speed or privacy.

button.label: Prompts
button.screentip: View and change the instructions PApii gives Claude
button.supertip: Edit the wording behind Draft Reply, Assist, Summarize and follow-ups, or the ground rules sent with every email. Each one can be reset to the built-in text.

button.label: Settings
button.screentip: Accounts, sign-off, storage and the Claude Code location
